SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ar.cust_no) AS active_customer_count
FROM txn t
JOIN acct_rel ar ON ar.acct_no = t.acct_no
WHERE t.txn_dt >= '20260701'
  AND t.txn_dt < '20261001'
  AND t.cncl_yn <> 'Y';

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
    CASE
        WHEN txn_cd IN ('입금', 'DEP') THEN amt
        WHEN txn_cd IN ('출금', 'WDR') THEN -amt
        ELSE 0
    END
), 0) AS 순입금액

  AND txn_dt >= '20260901'
  AND txn_dt < '20261001'
  AND txn_cd = 'IN'
  AND cncl_yn = 'N';

SELECT b.attr1
FROM acct AS a
JOIN brnc AS b ON b.brnc_cd = a.brnc_cd
WHERE a.acct_no = '110-000001';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_branch_count
FROM brnc;
